sources.title: Mitsuba Squeezes a 27B Vision Model Into 7.3 GB on One GPU - alphasignal.ai
sources.snippet: Mitsuba squeezes a 27B vision model into 7.3 GB Mitsuba is a ternary-quantized vision-language model designed to convert reference images into structured prompts for ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion, Krea, and similar generation tools. Its 27-billion-parameter base compresses to 7.3 GB or 6.0 GB, depending on the format, and the author reports that either build can run on a single 16 GB GPU.
